tests/cli/test_atrest.py::test_credentia.reason: Class 1 platform truth: permissive-directory ACL inheritance leaves four access entries on the born credential; the assert wants the single owner entry POSIX mode bits give.

tests/cli/test_atrest.py::test_setup_cre.reason: Class 1 platform truth: the born Windows ACL on the credential file carries multiple access entries (OWNER RIGHTS, Administrators, SYSTEM, runner user) where the POSIX-shaped assert wants exactly one owner entry (0600 semantics).

tests/cli/test_diagnose.py::test_w2_env_.reason: Class 1 platform truth: the monkeypatched Path.stat race stub never fires on Windows (the owner-only check reaches the file through the ACL path), so doctor exits 0 all-pass instead of emitting the expected FAIL row.

tests/cli/test_diagnose.py::test_x4_jour.reason: Class 1 platform truth: the journalctl stub path renders with backslashes on Windows, so the fixed-argv pin compares a POSIX-shaped path and refuses.

tests/cli/test_lifecycle.py::test_g12_fo.reason: Class 1/2: the signal-triggered decision records an adopted (status-carrying) decision on Windows instead of the bare shape — console-event signal delivery reaches a different decision path.

tests/cli/test_lifecycle.py::test_pidfil.reason: Class 1 platform truth: the file is born 0o666 on Windows (st_mode 33206), where the assert wants POSIX 0o600 mode bits.

tests/cli/test_lifecycle.py::test_s1twin.reason: Class 1/2 (timing-shaped): the detached spawn's readiness wait times out on the Windows runner ('no readiness within 30s'); unresolved whether spawn shape or pacing — row call: strict until weekly data shows flapping.
